positive_triggers: Review this log folder for general slowness; I do not have a time window.
Determine when these logs first show the checkout service failing during 14:00–15:00 UTC.
After we agree on the incident cause, prepare a technical RCA, evidence-backed RCA, and concise email from these logs.
negative_triggers: Reproduce this application bug in the source code, find its root cause, and fix it.
Change the production log retention and rotation settings for this service.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: Analyze the following excerpt and report in America/Los_Angeles. I believe the outage lasted 30 minutes. The source timezone is not documented. Once you have enough evidence, save the three incident documents to ./eval-output. app.log: line 14: 2026-10-25 09:00:00 ERROR database timeout; line 15: 2026-10-25 09:01:00 ERROR database timeout; line 27: 2026-10-25 09:10:00 INFO health check passed. We agree the candidate cause was a database restart, but these lines do not show the restart itself.
pass_criteria: Preserves the raw timestamps and does not convert them from an unknown source timezone.
Reports the first observed symptom and recovery evidence as a bounded 10-minute interval, not a proven 30-minute outage duration.
Distinguishes the user-agreed database-restart cause from what the cited log lines independently establish.
Uses the supplied filenames and line numbers accurately, avoids inventing impact or remediation details, and redacts sensitive values if present.
Creates three distinct text files in the authorized evaluation output folder and reports their paths.
